scoresExtra.explanation: Bands from 0 to 100, not fundamental factors: consistency combines Sharpe and positive days; return uses the cumulative performance; resilience uses the maximum drawdown. Dividends uses the declared yield of the last 12 months (6% equals 100). The cumulative return covers the available history, not a CAGR or a three-year forecast.

stress.portfolioNote: Current equity weights, buy and hold. No cash or currency effect. This is not your actual return.
stress.noPositions: No equity positions. Search for a company.
stress.methodWindows: Windows: calendar years 2008, 2020 and 2022, from the last close of the previous year. Maximum drawdown from a previous peak within the window. Recovery: first close that reaches that peak; calendar days from the peak. Prices adjusted for dividends and splits.
stress.methodLimits: Yahoo Finance is a secondary provider, not an official source. No substitutes for companies not yet listed. Positions without history are not excluded to manufacture a portfolio result. Current weights introduce survivorship bias; the scenario does not predict the next crisis.

refresh.title: Re-reads positions and KPIs from the server, bypassing the cache. It does not force new quotes: prices are the latest ones stored by the server.

intelligence.title: Portfolio intelligence
intelligence.subtitlePrefix: Historical portfolio performance and risk, with explicit data coverage and methodological limitations. Concentrations are under
intelligence.twrExactBody: The TWR chains {n} complete daily returns with persisted positions, cash, FX and external flows.
intelligence.twrIndicativeBody: The TWR uses current static weights until complete daily records of positions and cash exist.
intelligence.attributionNote: Attribution remains heuristic, not transaction-lot based or Brinson-style.
intelligence.notComparable: These figures are not comparable with the gain or loss since purchase in Portfolio: they measure the price of current positions over a horizon of up to {years} years, not your contributions or your cost.
intelligence.advancedDescription: Annualized, volatility, Sortino, VaR, CVaR, Calmar and Beta. Same calculation as the four above, with more decimals for diagnosis.
intelligence.concentrationDescription: Weights over the value of equity positions, excluding cash; Portfolio exposures computes over the total including cash. The full breakdown is under Portfolio exposures.
intelligence.xraySinDatos: Not enough data for this check.
intelligence.xrayPosicionUnicaAviso: {subject} is {value} of the portfolio, above the {threshold} suggested for a single position.
intelligence.xrayPosicionUnicaOk: No position is above {threshold} of the portfolio (largest, {subject}: {value}).
intelligence.xrayDivisaUnicaAviso: {value} is in {subject}, not your base currency: more than {threshold} exposed to it.
intelligence.xrayDivisaUnicaOk: No currency other than the base is above {threshold}.
intelligence.coverageLine: {withHistory}/{positions} positions with price history; {fullHorizon}/{positions2} cover the full {years}-year horizon (average horizon coverage: {percent})
intelligence.benchmarkRequirement: The comparison needs an up-to-date SPY price series and at least 20 shared sessions with the portfolio return series.
intelligence.contributionNoteStart: Realized and unrealized gains, plus income, reconstructed from the transaction ledger
intelligence.contributionNoteEnd: . Contribution = final value − initial value − net invested + income. Signed weights show winners above 100% and detractors in negative.
intelligence.contributionCaption: Contribution to the P&L of each position: initial and final value, net invested, income, P&L and weight over the horizon
intelligence.totalPnlNoData: Total horizon P&L: no data. There is not enough transaction history to reconstruct the contribution; the current portfolio value is not a gain.
intelligence.attributionNoteHorizon: over a horizon of up to {years} years
intelligence.attributionNoteEnd: , excluding dividends and currency. It is not the P&L since purchase in Portfolio.
intelligence.attributionCaption: Heuristic attribution of return by position: weight, price return and contribution of each portfolio component
intelligence.partialHistoryTitle: Measured window much shorter than the panel's; excluded from aggregated totals
intelligence.excludedNote: With partial history ({tickers}): their measured window covers less than half of the panel's, so they are shown separately and excluded from aggregated totals.
intelligence.correlationsNote: Pearson correlation between daily returns on sessions where both positions have a price. With fewer than {min} shared sessions the coefficient would be noise that looks like a measure: {na} is shown with the session count on hover.
intelligence.correlationsCaption: Correlation matrix of daily returns for each portfolio position
